newsitem.title: USA: EOTT buys 5,075 bpd Elk Hills crude - DOE.
newsitem.headline: EOTT buys 5,075 bpd Elk Hills crude - DOE.

text.p: EOTT Energy Corp will buy the 5,075 barrels-per-day (bpd) of light crude oil that was unsold after last week's Elk Hills Naval Petroleum Reserve auction here, U.S. Department of Energy said Friday.
EOTT, which initially bought 1,000 bpd of the 35 gravity crude, will now take delivery of 6,075 bpd in June and July, said a DOE spokeswoman.
EOTT will pay $17.68 a barrel for the crude, the price they initially bid in last week's auction.
The company bid the lowest, $1.41 less than Texaco Corp's refining unit.
The DOE last week offered 16,100 bpd of light crude to be delivered by pipeline, DOE said.
But only 11,025 bpd were requested from seven California refining and marketing companies, a lower-than-expected level of demand, according to the DOE.
Traders and DOE officials said demand was dampened because of stiff competition from high volumes of imported crudes.
"There is quite a bit of oil out there," said the DOE spokeswoman.
